title: Complements (B2): 了 (liǎo), 住, 开, 出来 / 起来, 坏了, 着 (zháo), V来V去
description: Can / can't at all (V得了 / V不了), holding fast (住), apart / open (开), coming out vs recalling, worn out, succeeding (着), and doing something over and over.

points.title: Verb + 得了 / 不了 (liǎo)
points.summary: 了 read liǎo as a complement = able to (at all): 吃不了 (can't eat it all / can't eat), 去不了 (can't go).
points.body:
- 这么多菜，我一个人吃**不了**.
- 我明天有事，去**不了**了.
examples: I've got something on tomorrow — I can't go.

points.title: Verb + 住 / 开
points.summary: 住 (zhù) = firmly, fixed (记住 remember, 站住 stop!). 开 (kāi) = open, apart (打开, 让开 move aside).
points.body:
- 我记**住**了你的电话号码.
- 人太多了，大家让**开**一下!

points.title: 出来 vs 起来 (perception, memory)
points.summary: 出来 = recognise / work out (听出来, 看出来, 想出来 an idea). 起来 = recall (想起来 a name / a fact).
points.body:
- 我听**出来**了，是你妈妈的声音.
- 我想**起来**了! 他叫小王.
examples: I remember now! His name is Xiao Wang.

points.title: Verb / adj + 坏了
points.summary: Verb + 坏 = break (摔坏). Adj / feeling + 坏了 = extremely (累坏了, 饿坏了).
points.body:
- 我的手机摔**坏**了.
- 今天把我累**坏了**.

points.title: Verb + 着 (zháo): succeed in
points.summary: 着 read zháo = the action succeeds: 睡着 (fall asleep), 找着 (find).

points.title: V来V去: over and over, back and forth
points.summary: Verb + 来 + verb + 去 = repeatedly / back and forth, often without result.
points.body:
- 他在房间里**走来走去**.
- 我**想来想去**，还是决定不去了.
examples: {他|tā}{在|zài}{房间|fángjiān}{里|lǐ}{走来走去|zǒu lái zǒu qù}。
He paced up and down the room.

notes: 吃不着 = 'can't get to eat it'.
questions.translation: There's so much food — I can't eat it all by myself.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{明天|míngtiān}{有|yǒu}{事|shì}，{去|qù}{不|bu}{了|liǎo}{了|le}。」 mean?
notes: 不了 is about ability, not wish.
让出 needs an object (让出座位).
questions.translation: It's too crowded — could everyone make way, please!

questions.prompt: {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{说|shuō}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{听|tīng}（　）{了|le}，{是|shì}{你|nǐ}{妈妈|māma}{的|de}{声音|shēngyīn}。
questions.translation: Don't tell me — I can tell, it's your mum's voice.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{叫|jiào}{什么|shénme}{来着|láizhe}？……{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}（　）{了|le}！{他|tā}{叫|jiào}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}。
notes: 想出来 = come up with (an idea) — a name you knew is recalled.
questions.translation: What was his name again? … I remember now! He's called Xiao Wang.
I wasn't careful and dropped my phone — it's broken.

questions.prompt: What does 「{今天|jīntiān}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{累|lèi}{坏|huài}{了|le}。」 mean?
notes: 坏了 after a feeling = extremely.

questions.translation: Shh, keep your voice down — the child is asleep.
After searching for ages, I finally found the keys.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{着急|zháojí}，{在|zài}{房间|fángjiān}{里|lǐ}{走来|zǒu lái}（　）。
questions.translation: He was anxious and paced up and down the room.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{想来想去|xiǎng lái xiǎng qù}，{还是|háishi}{决定|juédìng}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。」 mean?
notes: 决定不去 = decided not to go.
